description:
Amendment 0002 to RFP 19SN1026R0007:

This Amendment 0002 is issued to revise Section J, Exhibit G (Equipment Summary), to add two (2) additional HVAC units located in the Wine Storage Room. A revised Exhibit G is attached and replaces the previous version in its entirety.

All other terms and conditions remain unchanged.

The proposal due date is extended to March 09, 2026, 1630hrs (Singapore Time).
